title: Serwis o podatkach - Pliki do pobrania JPK VAT - Podatki.gov.pl
content:
Source list scan draft.

Source: MF podatki.gov.pl - e-deklaracje i JPK
URL: https://www.podatki.gov.pl/podatki-firmowe/jednolity-plik-kontrolny/jpk_vat/pliki-do-pobrania-jpk-vat/

Summary:
- The page is a general portal on taxes for businesses and individuals, hosted by podatki.gov.pl, with sections for personal taxes, entrepreneur taxes, duties, guides, news, tools, and online filing.
- It highlights downloadable resources and guidance related to tax forms and procedures, but it does not provide specific information about e-declarations or JPK VAT structures for 2026 on this page.
- For detailed, up-to-date information on JPK_V7M/V7K (JPK VAT) declarations and 2026 structure changes, you should navigate to the “Jednoli” (likely JPK VAT) section under “Podatki firmowe” or use the site’s search/tools for “JPK VAT” and 2026 updates.

If you need, I can pull the exact 2026 JPK_VAT structure details from podatki.gov.pl or guide you to the specific subsection.
